Name: test_invalid_password_returns_bad_credentials
Description:
Test that providing a valid username but an incorrect password
    returns a 200 OK containing 'Bad credentials' message.

Name: test_create_empty_body
Description: Test that creating a booking with an empty JSON body returns 400 or 415.

Name: test_bookingdates_has_checkin_and_checkout
Description: Test that the 'bookingdates' object contains 'checkin' and 'checkout' fields.

Name: test_get_booking_matches_schema
Description: Test that the GET /booking/:id response matches the defined JSON schema.

Name: test_empty_password_returns_bad_credentials
Description:
Test that providing an empty password returns a 200 OK 
    containing 'Bad credentials' message.

Name: test_create_negative_totalprice
Description:
BUG-005 — API accepts negative price without validation.
    Testing that the API allows creating a booking with a negative totalprice.

Name: test_auth_wrong_content_type
Description:
BUG-001 — API ignores Content-Type header and accepts requests.
    Test that sending auth request with wrong content type returns 415 or 400.
    (Documented quirk: currently returns 200).

Name: test_delete_without_token_returns_403
Description: Test that deleting a booking without a token returns a 403 Forbidden.

Name: test_get_booking_by_id_returns_200
Description:
Test that retrieving a specific booking by its ID returns a 200 OK.
    Uses the sample_booking fixture for setup and cleanup.

Name: test_delete_booking_returns_201
Description:
Test that deleting a booking returns a 201 Created status code.
    (Note: API quirk uses 201 instead of 204).

Name: test_valid_auth_returns_token
Description: Test that providing valid credentials returns 200 OK and a token string.

Name: test_auth_response_matches_schema
Description: Test that the POST /auth response matches the auth schema.

Name: test_totalprice_is_integer_not_string
Description: Test that the 'totalprice' field is of integer type.

Name: test_partial_update_firstname
Description: Test that a partial update (PATCH) of only the firstname field works correctly.

Name: test_update_without_token_returns_403
Description: Test that updating a booking without a token returns a 403 Forbidden.

Name: test_db_checkin_before_checkout
Description:
Test that no bookings in the database have a check-in date on or after checkout.
    Uses Query 5.

Name: test_get_all_bookings_returns_200
Description: Test that retrieving all booking IDs returns a 200 OK status code.

Name: test_create_booking_firstname_matches_request
Description: Test that the firstname of the created booking matches the request data.

Name: test_create_booking_response_matches_schema
Description: Test that the POST /booking response matches the wrapper schema.

Name: test_each_item_has_bookingid_key
Description: Test that every object in the booking list contains the 'bookingid' key.

Name: test_create_missing_firstname_field
Description:
Test that creating a booking with a missing required field (firstname) returns 400 or 500.
    Note: Restful-Booker often returns 500 for schema violations.

Name: test_patch_booking_response_matches_schema
Description: Test that the PATCH /booking/:id response matches the booking schema.

Name: test_full_update_booking
Description: Test that a full update (PUT) of a booking correctly modifies labels.

Name: test_double_delete_same_booking
Description: Test that deleting the same booking ID twice returns 405 or 404 on second attempt.

Name: test_booking_persisted_after_create
Description: Test that a booking created via API and inserted into DB is correctly persisted.

Name: test_delete_nonexistent_booking
Description:
Test that deleting a non-existent booking ID returns 405 Method Not Allowed.
    Note: Industry standard is 404, but this API quirky.

Name: test_auth_response_schema
Description: Test that the valid authentication response matches the expected JSON Schema.

Name: test_partial_update_totalprice
Description: Test that a partial update (PATCH) of only the totalprice field works correctly.

Name: test_put_booking_response_matches_schema
Description: Test that the PUT /booking/:id response matches the booking schema.

Name: test_partial_update_empty_body
Description: BUG-003 — PATCH with empty body returns 200, should be 400.

Name: test_create_and_persist_to_db
Description:
Test that a created booking can be successfully inserted into and 
    retrieved from the local SQLite database.

Name: test_deleted_booking_returns_404
Description: Test that a deleted booking cannot be retrieved and returns 404.

Name: test_db_firstname_not_null
Description:
Test that no bookings in the database have a NULL firstname.
    Uses Query 1.

Name: test_get_booking_returns_correct_data
Description: Test that retrieving a booking by ID returns the correct data keys.

Name: test_get_booking_with_string_id
Description: Test that retrieving a booking using a string ID instead of integer returns 404.

Name: test_db_row_count_matches_inserts
Description:
Test that the database row count correctly reflects the number of inserts performed.
    Uses Query 4.

Name: test_create_booking_returns_200
Description:
Test that creating a new booking returns a 200 OK status code.
    (Note: API quirk uses 200 instead of 201).

Name: test_empty_username_returns_bad_credentials
Description:
Test that providing an empty username returns a 200 OK 
    containing 'Bad credentials' message.

Name: test_db_totalprice_positive
Description:
Test that no bookings in the database have zero or negative totalprice.
    Uses Query 3.

Name: test_db_no_duplicate_booking_ids
Description:
Test that there are no duplicate booking_ids in the database.
    Uses Query 2.

Name: test_get_all_bookings_returns_list
Description: Test that retrieving all booking IDs returns a non-empty list.

Name: test_booking_all_required_fields_present
Description: Test that the booking object contains all required fields as per schema.

Name: test_create_booking_response_has_bookingid
Description: Test that the response of creating a booking includes the 'bookingid' key.

Name: test_get_nonexistent_booking_returns_404
Description: Test that retrieving a non-existent booking ID returns a 404 Not Found.
